blocks.text: Following a successful year in music, IV OF SPADES continues to make waves with compelling new singles, including the new alt-pop track “Susundan,” out now via Sony Music Entertainment. The new IV OF SPADES single will be part of their upcoming third studio album, TROPICAL DREAM, which is slated for release on December 9, 2026. A sincere but desperate take on romantic longing, “Susundan” explores the experience of pursuing someone who remains frustratingly out of reach. Blending retro sensibilities with ‘90s alt rock, the song champions a breezy, sun-soaked sound with an easygoing, cruising vibe. Written by Blaster Silonga and composed […]...
